pub fn outer(x: u32) -> u32 {
    fn inner(y: u32) -> u32 {
        fn innermost(z: u32) -> u32 { z + 1 }
        let c = |v: u32| { let d = |w: u32| w * 2; d(v) + 1 };
        c(y) + innermost(y)
    }
    struct S;
    impl S { fn m(&self, a: u32) -> u32 { let k = |q: u32| q + a; k(1) } }
    let cl = |a: u32| { let nested = |b: u32| b + a; nested(a) };
    inner(x) + cl(x) + S.m(x)
}
pub fn generic<T: Into<u32>>(t: T) -> u32 { let f = |v: u32| v + 1; f(t.into()) }
#[test]
fn t() { assert!(outer(1) > 0); assert!(generic(1u8) > 0); assert!(generic(1u16) > 0); }
